EGFR.rationale: EGFR-directed ADC/bispecifics in LUAD (amivantamab; patritumab deruxtecan partner axis)

ERBB2.rationale: HER2 ADC, trastuzumab deruxtecan approved for HER2-mutant NSCLC

MET.rationale: telisotuzumab vedotin, c-Met ADC, approved/advanced in c-Met-high NSCLC

TACSTD2.rationale: TROP2 ADC (sacituzumab govitecan / datopotamab deruxtecan) in NSCLC

CEACAM5.rationale: CEACAM5 ADC tusamitamab ravtansine, phase 3 non-squamous NSCLC

MSLN.rationale: mesothelin ADC and CAR-T programmes in lung adenocarcinoma

FOLR1.rationale: folate receptor alpha ADC mirvetuximab class, NSCLC expansion cohorts

CD276.rationale: B7-H3 ADC (ifinatamab deruxtecan) and CAR-T in lung cancer

ROR1.rationale: ROR1 ADC zilovertamab vedotin, NSCLC cohorts

EPCAM.rationale: pan-epithelial adhesion molecule; high in normal epithelium, catumaxomab-class toxicity

ATP1A1.rationale: Na+/K+ ATPase alpha-1, housekeeping pump expressed in every tissue

CGN.rationale: cingulin, cytoplasmic tight-junction plaque protein -- must fail the topology gate
